title: Make biblicus reinforcement-memory ML stack optional

comments.author: derek.norrbom
comments.text:
Move `biblicus[reinforcement-memory]` from core dependencies to a new `[rca]` optional extra in Tactus's pyproject.toml.

**Why:** The `biblicus[reinforcement-memory]` extra pulls in `bertopic` → `sentence-transformers` → `torch` (~900MB+). This makes every consumer of `tactus` download PyTorch and NVIDIA CUDA packages even when they never use RCA/rubric-memory functionality (e.g. the Plexus console chat worker Lambda).

**What is out of scope:** No changes to Tactus runtime logic. The RCA toolset and all existing tactus functionality remain identical — this is purely a packaging change so lightweight consumers can opt out of the ML stack.

**Definition of Done:** `pip install tactus` (bare) does NOT install torch/sentence-transformers. `pip install tactus[rca]` still installs the full biblicus reinforcement-memory stack. CI passes.
